resources.string: Lets your organisation\'s Nigafiy Fleet lock this phone, require a screen lock, turn the camera off, install or remove work apps and erase the phone. Every action is logged in Fleet.
Shown while Nigafiy manages this phone
Connected to %1$s. Inventory, security checks and the phone controls you allow.
Connected to %1$s. Your organisation manages this phone.
On the computer: Fleet → Enroll endpoint → Android. Then press Scan QR code here and point the phone at the code on the screen. Or paste the link, or type the three values.
That is not a Nigafiy enrollment code. In Fleet, open Enroll endpoint → Android and scan the app link code.
The QR scanner is not available on this phone (%1$s). Use Paste or type the values.
Nothing to paste: copy the link or the ldea_ token first.
This phone is managed by Nigafiy
Device Owner: lock, erase, camera, screen-lock policy and app installs are available to your IT
Admin phone: the full Nigafiy dashboard (Fleet included) and network alerts on this phone
Regular app: inventory, security checks and the controls in Settings; IT cannot lock or erase this phone
Allow Nigafiy to run in the background

What Nigafiy reads: model, Android version and security patch, storage, memory, battery, network addresses, installed apps and the security settings listed in Fleet. It never reads messages, photos, contacts, location or what you type. IT can also ask to see your screen (you are asked every time), control it if you turned that on in Accessibility, open your shared files if you allowed All files access, ring the phone and send you a message. Each of these is shown on the phone while it happens.
Your organisation erased this phone through Nigafiy.
%1$s rang this phone so it can be found. Tap Stop to end it.
IT asks to see your screen
%1$s asks to see your screen. Reason: %2$s
Nothing is shared until you agree
If you share, they see your whole screen, including notifications, until you or they stop. Android will ask you once more. Nothing is recorded on the phone.
Remote control is on: they can also tap, swipe and press Back, Home and Recent apps. A bar stays on top of the screen while they can.
They can only look: remote control is off on this phone.
%1$s can see your screen. Tap Stop to end it.
%1$s can see and control your screen. Tap Stop to end it.
Lets IT tap and swipe on this phone, only during a screen-sharing session you accepted, while a bar on top of the screen says so. Nigafiy never reads what is on the screen or what you type.
IT must ask you every time, and Android asks again. Android shows its cast icon while your screen is shared.
IT can tap and swipe, only during a screen session you accepted. A bar on top of the screen says so.
To allow it, turn on Nigafiy in Settings → Accessibility.
Shared storage only: Download, DCIM, Documents and the like. App data stays private.
To allow it, turn on All files access for Nigafiy.
IT can ring this phone and show you a message. Both appear as notifications.
So Nigafiy keeps working in the background and can show its notices.
Each one is your own switch. Whatever IT does shows on this phone while it happens.
If Android says "App was denied access" or the switch is greyed out: open App info, tap ⋮ (top right) → Allow restricted settings, confirm, then turn Nigafiy on in Accessibility.
Turns Nigafiy off completely on this phone: no connection, no reports, no screen view or control, no notification. Nothing runs, not even after a restart, until you open this app again.
Nigafiy shows this phone as offline until you open this app again. Opening it turns everything back on.
No problems on your network. Important problems show up here and as notifications.
The dashboard did not open: %1$s. Check that this phone can reach the Nigafiy computer, then try again.
This phone is not an admin phone any more. An admin can make it one again in Fleet.
Phone controls, stop and log out

Network tools: the checks, ping, Wi-Fi details and device search run on this phone and are not sent to Nigafiy. Only the speed test talks to an outside service (speed.cloudflare.com), when you press its button.
Finds out whether a problem is the Wi-Fi, the router or the internet, and what to do.
Testing the router, the internet and website names (about 10 seconds).
The check could not run. Try again.
The Wi-Fi, the router and the internet all answer quickly.
This phone is not on Wi-Fi or mobile data. Turn on Wi-Fi and pick your network.
The phone is on Wi-Fi but the router does not reply. Move closer, or restart the router (unplug it for 10 seconds).
Your router works, but the internet behind it does not answer. Restart the router; if that does not help, the problem is with your internet provider.
The internet works, but looking up website names fails. Restart the router, or set its DNS to 1.1.1.1.
The signal is weak where you are. Move closer to the router, or away from thick walls and the microwave.
Some replies were lost, so calls and games may stutter. Check again next to the router: if it is fine there, the Wi-Fi is the problem; if not, the line is.
The internet answers, but slowly. Something on the network may be downloading, or your provider is busy.
Live signal: walk around with this open to find where it is best.
One ping a second, with a graph. Spikes and red ticks show lag and lost replies.
Pick a target and press Start.
Download and upload speed. Uses Cloudflare\'s public speed test (speed.cloudflare.com) and up to about 100 MB of data; nothing goes to Nigafiy.
The speed test could not reach Cloudflare. Check the connection and try again.
From this phone to the nearest Cloudflare server.
Who is on your Wi-Fi right now. Names come from your router; Nigafiy on the computer also shows each device\'s maker, type and history.
Connect to Wi-Fi first: the search looks at the network this phone is on.
Removes this phone from Nigafiy: the server forgets it and this app goes back to the sign-up screen. To connect it again you need a new code from Nigafiy.
This phone leaves Nigafiy. The network tools keep working.
Logged out. Nigafiy no longer manages this phone.
Logged out on this phone. Nigafiy could not be reached, so it still lists the phone until you remove it there.
